title: Diagnosing autoimmune encephalitis in psychiatry: clinical recommendations and unresolved challenges from the GENERATE network
title_zh: 精神科诊断自身免疫性脑炎：GENERATE网络的临床建议与未解决的挑战
abstract: Abstract Psychiatric syndromes can be caused by underlying autoimmune encephalitis (AE). This represents a diagnostic challenge at the interface of psychiatry and neurology. While AE mostly manifests with a combined, complex neuropsychiatric syndrome, some patients with AE may (initially) present with predominant or isolated psychiatric symptoms. These cases can be difficult to classify, and diagnostic approaches vary considerably across clinical settings. This paper from the GErman NEtwork for Research on AuToimmune Encephalitis (GENERATE) provides interdisciplinary expert recommendations from psychiatry and neurology for the diagnostic evaluation of patients with suspected AE as the cause of psychiatric syndromes for psychiatric care settings. It integrates current scientific evidence with practical, empirical considerations from routine clinical care in different healthcare settings. The proposed diagnostic approach to detect psychiatric manifestations of AE emphasizes a rational, stepwise evaluation incorporating clinical assessment, magnetic resonance imaging, electroencephalography, blood testing, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis, and neuronal/glial antibody testing in serum and CSF. In diagnostically ambiguous individuals, [¹⁸F]fluorodeoxyglucose positron-emission-tomography and advanced antibody testing (e.g., live-cell-based assays) or neuroimaging techniques (e.g., volumetric analysis) may provide additional supportive information. Typical findings and limitations of diagnostic modalities are discussed to facilitate appropriate interpretation and to avoid under-recognition or overdiagnosis. Importantly, these recommendations do not aim to define new disease entities or diagnostic criteria, but rather to support a harmonized and pragmatic diagnostic approach to patients presenting with psychiatric syndromes suspected to be caused by underlying AE. Finally, key unresolved issues in this evolving field of immunopsychiatry are outlined, and promising research strategies are described.
abstract_zh: 摘要：精神症状可能由潜在的自身免疫性脑炎（AE）引起，这在精神科与神经科交叉点构成了诊断难题。AE 通常表现为复杂的神经精神综合征，但部分患者最初仅出现主要或孤立的精神症状，难以归类，且不同临床环境的诊断方法差异显著。本文来自德国自身免疫性脑炎研究网络（GENERATE），提供了精神科与神经科的跨学科专家建议，针对精神科护理环境中疑似由 AE 引起的精神症状患者的诊断评估。建议将最新科学证据与不同医疗环境中的常规临床实践相结合，提出一种理性、分步的诊断流程：包括临床评估、磁共振成像、脑电图、血液检测、脑脊液（CSF）分析以及血清和 CSF 中的神经/胶质细胞抗体检测。在诊断不明确的个体中，可使用 [¹⁸F]氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描（PET）和高级抗体检测（如活细胞法）或神经影像技术（如体积分析）获取额外支持信息。文中讨论了各诊断手段的典型发现与局限性，以便正确解读并避免低估或过度诊断。重要的是，这些建议并非旨在定义新的疾病实体或诊断标准，而是支持对疑似由 AE 引起的精神症状患者进行统一、务实的诊断方法。最后，概述了该免疫精神病学领域的关键未解决问题，并描述了有前景的研究策略。
